title: dsm-firmenich opens new Fine Fragrance flagship in Chelsea, New York
summary: The fragrance maker has opened what it calls its “flagship for Fine Fragrance” at 641 Avenue of the Americas in Chelsea, New York City. The new 44,000-square-foot space brings together perfumers, fragrance development teams, application, digital, and compounding capabilities under one roof. Home to around 100 employees, including nine Fine Fragrance perfumers, the new Chelsea location is designed to foster deeper collaboration, inspire creativity, and accelerate innovation alongside clients... - Industry buzz / North America
